Did better this week. My average daily caloric intake during the week was 1755 cal. I met my goal of consuming between than 1200-1800 cal 6 days. I went to a baseball game which lead to about 2800 calories for that day. I splurged and got a burger for lunch and then at the ballpark, I got a bratwurst, ice cream and beer. We also were given a free pretzel which added 400 more calories. My ave caloric intake the rest of the week was 1584 cal. I made a point to eat better during the week since I had slacked off and had too many cheat days recently. In the past 4 weeks, I have had 8 cheat days, 7 of which were 2200+ calories.

According to my logging site, I've used 2840 more cal than I ate for the week. This should translate to 0.81 lbs. of real weight lose.

I lifted weights twice this week. I'm working my way back up to the highest I've lifted.

Failures:

* Over did my cheat meal

Exercises:

* Squat: 150 lbs - 5x5 155 lbs - 5x5 * OHP: 55 lbs - 5x5 * Deadlift: 175 lbs - 5 * Bench Press: 100 lbs - 5x5 * Pendlay Row: 110lbs - 5x5

I've lost 40 pounds this year. I am done losing weight for now. I have visible abs, and according to a pinch test I did, I'm down to about 11% body fat. I feel like I have accomplished my goal of a six pack as well as I can right now. I am ready to begin overeating to put on muscle mass. I plan to increase my calories with drinking milk and choosing higher calorie meals from time to time. From what I've been reading, I'll need to consume between .8 and 1 gram of protein a day, which comes out to 128 - 160 grams. I have been consuming about 100g each day while keeping my calories down so I don't think I'll have much problem getting enough protein. With my wedding coming up in October, I will need to get a suit in September and I want to maintain my weight after I get the suit. I will want to cut the extra fat before getting my suit, so I will probably only eat at a surplus for the next 8-10 weeks. I will continue to monitor my weight but I will not be listing my total lost pounds anymore since it wouldn't make sense to deduct from it when I am purposely putting on weight. My goals now are to increase the weight of my different lifts by different amounts by the time I am ready to cut in August. I want to get my squats to 200 lbs, deadlift to 205 lbs, OHP to 70 lbs, bench press to 125 lbs, and my pendlay row to 130 lbs.
